summary: This directory provides the infrastructure for retrieving market-specific holiday schedules. It defines an abstraction layer to fetch calendar data, ensuring consistent access to market holiday information across the application.
responsibilities: Define the interface for market holiday data retrieval
Provide a service wrapper to manage holiday schedule access
relationships: The service interface dictates the contract for data retrieval while the wrapper class implements this functionality.
The HolidayFetcher relies on the defined service interface to ensure consistent integration with market-specific calendars.
designDecisions: Use of an interface to decouple the fetcher implementation from the service consumers
Service wrapper pattern to encapsulate retrieval logic
